## Checklist

- [ ] I edited a file in `data/sections/`, not `README.md` (it's generated)
- [ ] The project meets [what makes a good entry](https://github.com/pluja/awesome-privacy/blob/main/misc/Contributing.md#what-makes-a-good-entry): public code, 6+ months old with a stable release, real users, private by default
- [ ] The description is one plain sentence, with no marketing words
